content:
Rein Zustand said:

I see, the reason why I wanted to use it was for Claude to read a conversation in a topic. Claude wasn't able to read the web-public version because it requires JS to render the content. The archive is the only viable way. I will raise this issue to chat.zulip.org to see what they think.

I requested for this feature on chat.zulip.org, and they delivered it: https://leanprover.zulipchat.com/llms.txt . In any agentic tool, tell them to read the llms.txt, and it will be able to read the conversation of a topic as a context. Note that they are limited to web-public channels.
I was under the impression that scraping was against zulip TOS? I could be mistaken though

I am not a lawyer, but I don't think this counts as scraping: https://zulip.com/policies/rules

  • Do not automatically create or access accounts for the Services (a.k.a. “scraping”) by means other than our publicly supported interfaces. If you wish to embed Zulip as the chat backend for your own product, you must self-host your own Zulip server, rather than using Zulip Cloud.
If Zulip is providing it then I assume it's meant to be used. More info on the format: https://llmstxt.org
